briefs.brief_text: Lautaro Martinez enters this Serie A fixture with 12 goals this season, leading an Internazionale attack that hosts Parma at San Siro. Internazionale currently holds 1st place in the table, while Parma sits 14th and aims to disrupt the league leaders through a compact defensive block and quick counterattacks.

The Raptors turned a tight contest into a statement, closing the final two minutes with a flurry of shot-making that left the Clippers scrambling. Nimari Burnett’s cold-blooded triple with just over a minute remaining broke the tension, while Yuki Kawamura’s late-game heroics sealed the 114-106 victory. Toronto’s defensive intensity in the clutch—a stifling 72.4 rating—proved far too much for Los Angeles to navigate in the closing seconds.

The Hawks escaped Gainbridge Fieldhouse with a 119-117 victory, proving that their clutch-time efficiency is more than just a statistical quirk. Atlanta’s defensive rating of 100 in tight spots held firm when the game tightened, forcing the Pacers into a frantic scramble. It was a gritty, high-stakes finish that reminds us why we watch: the game is never truly over until the final whistle blows.

Detroit’s struggles in the clutch—a dismal -20.3 net rating—proved fatal when the game tightened up.
